li.label: tournament champion
li.description: I won the jousting tournament! The crowd chanted my name and now everyone knows what I can do.

li.label: crowned queen of love and beauty
li.description: The tournament champion crowned me queen of love and beauty in front of everyone. What an honour!

li.label: watched a joust
li.description: I watched a jousting tournament! The charges, the lances breaking, the crowd shouting. That was a great day.

li.label: thrill of the impact
li.description: That lance slamming into me at full charge... I have to admit, it did something for me.

li.label: passed over at the tournament
li.description: The champion rode right past me to crown someone else, in front of the whole colony. The shame of it. I won't forget this.

li.label: out of the tournament
li.description: I got knocked out of the tournament. Oh well, that's how it goes, I'll get them next time.

li.label: out of the tournament
li.description: Unhorsed and knocked out of the tournament, in front of everyone too. That stings.

li.label: humiliated at the tournament
li.description: Thrown out of the tournament like a rookie, in front of the whole colony. I want to crawl into a hole.
